note: Plain explanations of the patterns (pattern id -> one line for a beginner: what the learner can say with it, about 60 characters at most, lower case, no full stop; allowed terms: noun, verb, adjective, polite, past, question and the form names of pack-forms.json). Applied by scripts/generate-pack-ja.mjs as each pattern's ds; the old wording from the source stays only as the fallback in the audit note, and --check fails for a pattern without an entry. Each was written after reading the sentences of the pack that use the pattern.
